name: Meguro Masato
source:
Type: human
Skills: exorcising ayakashi
Occupation: onmyoji (for illegal purposes)
Location: Kabukicho

[i]"It's been a long time since I've been asked that. I murder any ayakashi in my way, so it's no surprise."[/i]

A mysterious man who is a skilled onmyoji but appears to only take commissions through criminal channels. He acts as a lone wolf, coming and going as he pleases, and annihilates any ayakashi he lays his eyes on without hesitation.

He puts on airs of superiority and confidence, but has the skills to back it up and only knows how to use brute force. There are times he will do anything―even resorting to dirty tactics―to get what he wants, but other times he neglects his job. 

His aggressive, merciless tactics have not only earned scorn from the people around him, but brought him to the attention of the ayakashi. 

[Edited from [url=https://twitter.com/i/events/1495144875670573056]Moonchime Localization[/url]]
translation:
类型：人类
技能：驱除妖怪
职业：阴阳师（非法活动）
地点：歌舞伎町

[i]“已经很久没人这样问我了。我会杀死挡在路上的所有妖怪，当然不足为奇。”[/i]

一名阴阳术高超的神秘男子，但似乎只通过犯罪渠道接受委托。他独来独往，随心所欲地来去，毫不犹豫地消灭目光所及的每只妖怪。

他摆出傲慢自信的架势，也确实有实力支撑，只是只会用蛮力。有时为了得到想要的东西，他什么都做得出来，甚至使用卑鄙手段；有时却又会把工作抛在脑后。

他激进而无情的手段不仅招来身边人的鄙夷，也引起妖怪的注意。

[根据[url=https://twitter.com/i/events/1495144875670573056]Moonchime Localization[/url]编辑。]
